abilities.name: Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost
_curatorNotes: Heal effects authored 2026-07-12 for the 'tag without effect' audit finding (skill tagged heal). Two heal mechanisms, both ATK-scaled and snapshot at cast in gcsim (c.skillHealSnapshot).

On-hit heal ('Regeneration on Hit'): gcsim burst.go onNACAHitHook() fires c.Core.Player.Heal on every Qiqi Normal/Charged hit (AttackTagNormal | AttackTagExtra) while skillBuffKey ('qiqi-e') is active. Target -1 = whole party → target 'team'; gated on Herald of Frost active → condition state 'duringSummon'. Authored as two effects (onHit abilityType normal + charged) since the onHit trigger takes a single abilityType. TL10 (index 9): skillHealOnHitPer[9]=0.19008 → 19.008% ATK, skillHealOnHitFlat[9]=148.30853 (sidecar 'Regeneration on Hit' col 10 = '19.01% ATK+148').

Continuous heal ('Continuous Regeneration'): gcsim skill.go — one proc immediately at skillHitmark=32 (= summon spawnsAt), then skillHealTickTask re-queues every 4.5*60=270f. Authored as a summonTick on the Herald of Frost summon (Kuki ring / Diona heal-tick shape), interval 4.5, firstTickDelay 0 for the immediate-on-spawn proc → ~4 ticks over the 15s window (0/4.5/9/13.5s; gcsim comment '3 additional times'). Target c.Core.Player.Active() → target 'active'. TL10 (index 9): skillHealContPer[9]=1.2528 → 125.28% ATK, skillHealContFlat[9]=991.2866 (sidecar 'Continuous Regeneration' col 10 = '125.28% ATK+991').

Herald of Frost's Cryo coordinated-attack DMG ticks (Skill Damage / Coordinated Attack DMG sidecar rows) are NOT authored here — out of scope for this heal-only finding; the skill is not tagged coordinatedAttack.
abilities.description:
Using the Icevein Talisman, Qiqi brings forth the Herald of Frost, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents.

Herald of Frost
·On hit, Qiqi's Normal and Charged Attacks regenerate HP for your own party members and nearby teammates. Healing scales based on Qiqi's ATK.
·Periodically regenerates your active character's HP.
·Follows the character around, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in their path.

abilities.name: Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune
_curatorNotes: Fortune-Preserving Talisman is an enemy-attached status effect modeled as a summon (no mobility field, per Mona Illusory Bubble precedent). spawnsAt=40 from talismanAi QueueAttack(…, 40, 40, talismanCB) in burst.go, which fires before main DMG at burstHitmark=82. Duration 15s from e.AddStatus(talismanKey, 15*60).
abilities.description:
Qiqi releases the adeptus power sealed within her body, marking nearby opponents with a Fortune-Preserving Talisman that deals Cryo DMG.

Fortune-Preserving Talisman
When opponents affected by this Talisman take DMG, the character that dealt this DMG regenerates HP.

passives.name: Life-Prolonging Methods
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. A1: when the active char is under Herald of Frost and triggers any elemental reaction, they gain +20% IncomingHealingBonus for 8s. gcsim subscribes to all reaction events (ReactionEventStartDelim+1 through ReactionEventEndDelim) and checks skillBuffKey active (asc.go:a1()). Probable trigger: onReaction with condition that Herald of Frost is active; reaction list needs KQM verification.
passives.description: When a character under the effects of Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost triggers an Elemental Reaction, their Incoming Healing Bonus is increased by 20% for 8s.

constellations.name: Ascetics of Frost
_curatorNotes: trigger: 'manual' is inherited from generator; reviewer to replace. Probable trigger: onHit from Herald of Frost deployable damage (skill tick) hitting a Fortune-Preserving Talisman-marked enemy. In gcsim, c1() callback is appended to Herald tick AttackEvents and checks e.StatusIsActive(talismanKey) (cons.go:c1()). Energy +2 per qualifying hit; no per-hit ICD modeled in gcsim. Target scope: self.
